profile.description: 一类通过 USB HID 连接的物理按键控制面板，可读取按键状态，并控制状态指示灯与按键背光。适合在实验系统中用作人工触发、模式切换、状态显示和自定义快捷控制界面。
profile.description_en: A physical USB HID keypad/control panel that can read button states and control status LEDs and key backlighting. It is suitable for manual triggering, mode switching, status indication, and custom shortcut control in laboratory setups.
